crossRefs.note: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four horns.
Therefore Yahweh says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says Yahweh of Armies…
He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of…
Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits…
Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he…
A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise, and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship…
He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

translations.web: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
translations.bsb: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.
translations.kjv: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
translations.asv: And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
